title: Bar Tzitai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Yevamot 21b, Abaye tells Rava, “For example, the daughter-in-law of the house of Bar Tzitai.” In Moed Katan 4b, Rav Yehudah permits the members of the house of Bar Tzitai to make water basins around their vines. Rashi explains Tzitai as a place-name, but Hyman observes that Yevamot 21b suggests a family name.

notes.text: Rashi explains the basins as pits beneath vines and olive trees, into which water is placed.
